A.name: Rush creator
A.desc: Scores from everywhere — a spread diet, driven off the rush.

B.name: Perimeter shooter
B.desc: Lives in the circles — beats goalies clean from mid-range.

C.name: Slot finisher
C.desc: Home-plate diet — his shots come from the slot, and they convert.

D.name: Net-front
D.desc: Crease and net-side diet — tips, rebounds and clean-up goals.

E.name: Point shooter
E.desc: The offense runs through his point shot from the blue line.

F.name: Activating defenseman
F.desc: Jumps into the play — shoots from the circles and slot like a forward.
